offering_description.value: Provides technology consulting, engineering, and mission support primarily to U.S. defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. Its teams build and integrate software, data, and cybersecurity systems and help clients operate them.

primary_products.value: Mission software platforms; data analysis tools; cybersecurity software; tactical command and control kits

quotes.quote: Booz Allen offers a range of software platforms, analytical tools, and cybersecurity accelerators that seamlessly integrate today’s most advanced technology with bold thinking and unparalleled expertise. We specialize in designing intelligent, tailor-made solutions built to tackle the nation’s most critical missions.
How Mobile Detachment Kit Edge accelerates battle management

primary_services.value: technology and management consulting; software and systems engineering; cybersecurity; data analytics and AI implementation; mission operations support

customer_segment.value: B2G: U.S. military departments, intelligence agencies, and civilian federal agencies; B2B: federal prime contractors and commercial enterprises

end_markets.value: defense; intelligence and national security; civilian public administration; healthcare and public health; financial services

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Consulting labor, system development and integration, and ongoing mission support under contracts and task orders

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Combines specialist labor and technology to build and operate systems for agencies and federal prime contractors

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with support for U.S. government missions in Europe and the Indo-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Consulting, systems engineering, cybersecurity, analytics and AI, and mission support for federal programs

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Agency procurements through competitive bids, contract vehicles, and task orders; partners / resellers: Federal prime contractors that award subcontracts to Booz Allen

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Federal acquisition and defense procurement rules, security clearance requirements for classified work, and contract cybersecurity standards

notes: I’m uncertain which software offerings are sold separately from consulting and implementation contracts.
